notes.title: Server Shutdown Announcement
notes.content:
Dear gamers:
This game will officially terminate the game operation on January 4, 2025, and all servers will be shut down. Players will not be able to log in to the game after the server is shut down.
Since the first day of testing, it has been supported by the majority of players. Every update touches our hearts, and every activity makes us passionate. We have grown up with the game and have a feeling for the game that you can't give up.
It is also an extremely painful choice for us to close the partner who has accompanied us through the days and nights. However, everything will die one day. Due to force majeure, we can only put down our feelings and use our last efforts to do the final operation work. I hope you can accompany us to experience the remaining game time.

Service shutdown process schedule:
1. At 12:00 on November 4, 2024, the game will release a suspension announcement, and the game version update will be stopped at the same time.
2. The game recharge will be closed at 12:00 on December 4, 2024. Players can continue to use the diamonds in their current account until the server is shut down.
3. The operation service of this game will be stopped at 12:00 on January 4, 2025, and all regions and servers will be inaccessible at this time.

notes.title: Faction Matching Strategy
notes.content:
There are many monsters in the game, each with its own camp attributes. Reasonable matching can give you an advantage in the game.

1. Start by understanding the camp attributes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/58f383129930eb56aa84bcc441b1518d6bfb36a1.png

Each monster has its own attributes, which are
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/83162748720f933191795e4b602425b58bf0074d.pngfire
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/9ed690adba1a39f1bc86cf77cf69f784b5306305.pngWind
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/7c7f00b98fc1f268b11d642260b5e778cb52b8eb.pngland
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/106cf38aa5fadecb34a50c4eef22881dffcc8e43.pngWater
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/a36072ac3d7ec47309a830907eb8e9966552765f.pngLight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/c2af650f10feaf66164b7a6bc0ba9794673a1ed8.pngDark
There is a restraint relationship between attributes, which can increase damage bonus. Fire restrains wind, wind restrains earth, earth restrains water, and water restrains fire. Light and dark restrain each other. There is no damage bonus if there is no restraint relationship.

2. When the player is in the novice stage, there are few monsters and few choices. You can temporarily ignore the restraint of attributes and start with the formation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/8f879f2fcf0d68732eb3aa0145dd9f5222f4d0be.png

When playing any game, you can choose a formation. You can choose a defensive or damaging formation to improve the monsters and complete the level.

For the selection of monsters, you can refer to the [Recommended lineup] we prepared for players.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/af1999b3d4888e824c93162fd208c1b5df4395a9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/48fa25a085b0654e8d9871cc883691fd6da4ed8d.png

If there are recommended monsters, you can go to the battle, and then match the corresponding formation, which will have a miraculous effect in the early clearance of the main line, the Holy Spirit Tower, and even the arena.

3. After the player has passed the previous novice period and has a considerable number of monsters, he can further match his own monsters to burst out the monsters with stronger strength.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/7ddc7599605262d230c77e392fb20cebebcdc738.png

For example, in the Holy Spirit Tower, most of the enemy's monsters are fire-attributed, so you can choose more water-attributed monsters to restrain the enemy. If your water-attributed monsters are all mages and are relatively fragile, then you can choose a defensive formation, both offensive and defensive, to cause the greatest restraint on the enemy!

4. In the later stages of the game, as the monsters are gradually complete, you can even form a single-attribute monster, because you can get the maximum attribute bonus in the race bonus. Further improve your monster combat power! But when forming this single-attribute team, be careful that the opponent is a team that just restrains you, otherwise it will not be worth the loss.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/1b1ff32105e9410ffcd44a1cc78dd2ec20739354.png

5. Enter the game to experience the actual faction matching. Maybe you can find a better match. After all, the monsters in the game can also achieve better combinations with each other!

notes.title: Game upgrade guide
notes.content:
In the game, upgrading monsters is a very important function. It can not only greatly improve the combat power of monsters, but also increase the upper limit of monster levels. Upgrading monsters is essential. Now let's explain the upgrading of monsters.

Select the tab [Upgrade] in the monster enhancement interface, and we can see the monsters and quantities required for upgrading.
1. As you can see from the picture below, you need an elite quality (purple) monster of the same quality to upgrade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/21fc688ebc59e5fb065c5ea9be81480079a38adc.png

2. If the upgrade conditions are met, a [+] special effect will be displayed here, indicating that the upgrade can be performed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/cac7ce1c7ad47ea2e0b70ed33d04c3b5b22d2ee9.png

3. Then click the [Upgrade Button] or click the icon, and the selection interface will pop up, and the interface will automatically filter out the monsters that can be used as materials.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/b1be0ad7a97ef72191707f3fe14d4ce712261d04.png

4. After selecting a monster, click the OK button, and the selection interface will be automatically closed. Then the selected monster will be put into the upgrade process and wait for the player's final confirmation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/b1fea6ce13268164290036a8912ce37823dc258c.png

5. Finally, click [Upgrade] to upgrade. You can see the improvement of attributes, combat power, level limit, and the quality of the monster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/f78b2e23c9d7818a598608605f69939e450a658c.png

6. After the upgrade is completed, the interface will display the number of monsters required to upgrade to the next level, quality requirements, etc. Repeat the above steps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214270/fc04a9eb7a485104c6dd14bd3ab7c32ff771dca3.png

Well, today's guide ends here~ I wish you all a happy game!
